## Checklist
- [ ] Scope is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, or failures and skipped checks are explained.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Authorization, MFA, consent, audit, and ledger boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, vault files, or local deployment records are included.
- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
